profile.name: Suriya Dhayalan
profile.tagline: MERN Stack Developer building SaaS products, AI solutions, and scalable web applications.
profile.specialization: MongoDB · Express · React · Node.js — SaaS, AI & Scalable Web Apps
profile.bio: Full-Stack MERN Developer with 2.5+ years of experience building scalable web applications, AI-powered platforms, and enterprise solutions. Skilled in React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and MongoDB, with expertise in modern frontend architecture and API-driven development. Led the development of AI-enabled products, including real-time deepfake detection systems, recruitment platforms, and Chrome Extension-based solutions. Proven ability to own end-to-end product delivery — from design and development to deployment and production optimization.

experience.summary: Building the company's web presence and AI-powered recruitment & meeting-security products end to end.
highlights: Corporate Website Development — Designed and developed the company's official website with a modern, responsive, and user-friendly interface aligned with business objectives. Managed end-to-end implementation, testing, and deployment to ensure a seamless digital experience.

Intelli Hire Platform — Built the Intelli Hire product environment, creating intuitive workflows, dashboards, and recruitment management interfaces. Focused on delivering an efficient and scalable user experience for hiring and verification processes.

AI-Powered Deepfake Detection Extension — Developed a Google Meet Chrome Extension integrated with backend APIs for real-time participant analysis and deepfake detection. Led integration, testing, and deployment to deliver a production-ready fraud prevention solution.

experience.summary: Engineered high-performance dashboard experiences supporting business-critical workflows.
highlights: Engineered scalable web applications using React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript, delivering high-performance dashboard experiences that supported business-critical workflows and enhanced user engagement.

Architected reusable component libraries and modular frontend frameworks, significantly improving code maintainability, development velocity, and long-term product scalability across multiple projects.
Integrated and optimized RESTful API ecosystems to enable real-time data visualization, seamless system communication, and data-driven decision-making through intuitive user interfaces.

Translated complex product requirements and Figma designs into pixel-perfect, responsive user experiences using React.js, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS, ensuring consistency, accessibility, and cross-device compatibility.

experience.summary: Developed scalable, responsive interfaces and integrated REST APIs for production features.
highlights: Developed scalable and responsive user interfaces using React.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS based on design and product requirements.
Improved application performance through component optimization, efficient state management using React Hooks and Context API, and cross-browser compatibility enhancements.
Collaborated with designers and backend teams to integrate REST APIs and deliver seamless, production-ready frontend features.

projects.title: ATNA Meeting Guardian
projects.subtitle: Real-time AI meeting security
projects.description: A real-time AI meeting security platform with a Chrome Extension that captures participant frames from live Google Meet sessions, runs TensorFlow.js + MediaPipe models to detect deepfakes and suspicious behavior, and surfaces risk scores on a live Next.js dashboard via Socket.io.
highlights: Built a real-time AI meeting security platform with a Chrome Extension that captures participant frames and activity from live Google Meet sessions
Integrated TensorFlow.js and MediaPipe models to detect deepfakes, face swaps, and suspicious behavioral patterns in real time
Developed backend APIs and analysis pipelines to process captured frames, generate risk scores, and store detection results
Created a Next.js dashboard with Socket.io-based live updates to display participant insights, alerts, and meeting security analytics

projects.title: Job Portal Web Application
projects.subtitle: Full-stack recruitment platform
projects.description: A full-stack job portal with role-based access for Job Seekers, Employers, and Admins. Features NextAuth authentication, resume uploads via Cloudinary, job posting/application management, and end-to-end applicant tracking.
highlights: Built a full-stack job portal using Next.js 14, TypeScript, MongoDB (Mongoose), and Tailwind CSS
Implemented role-based access for Job Seekers, Employers, and Admins, with secure NextAuth authentication
Enabled resume uploads via Cloudinary, job posting/application management, and applicant tracking
Delivered an end-to-end recruitment platform with intuitive workflows for every user role
